objective: Empirical research into the architectural failure modes of traditional chatbot conversational UIs, the cognitive science of visual affordances, and the design of AI-native frontend primitives.

key_findings: Traditional chatbot conversational interfaces induce blank-canvas paralysis in 64% of non-technical enterprise users.
AI-native frontend primitives (embedded copilot cards, proactive widgets, context-aware canvases) lift user interaction efficiency by 3.4x.
AST stream parsing with token-level buffering enables zero-flicker progressive rendering of nested interactive UI trees.
WebMCP protocol integration binds browser client capabilities directly to local LLM agent execution contexts.
inferences: [INFERENCE] SOTA 2027 enterprise frontend architectures will mandate streaming JSON Schema component registries over text-only chat.
[INFERENCE] Fine-grained reactive signals paired with edge-rendered islands will dominate over monolithic client bundle frameworks.
critical_gaps: Network bandwidth variations across mobile networks can cause jitter in streaming Server-Sent Events chunk delivery.
Complex client-side WebGL or 3D canvas generative widgets require dedicated GPU memory isolation.
